coreLoop: Spawn into the arena (up to 25 players per server).
Survive the current zombie wave — kills and survival earn Credits.
Use the buy phase between waves to upgrade weapon / health / place gear (turrets, barricades).
Push the wave counter higher for increased Credit payout — leaderboard ranks max wave reached.
Auto Skip: server-wide vote to end buy phase early and start the next wave faster.

earlyPhase.title: Early waves — bank Credits
earlyPhase.body: Kill efficiently with the starter handgun. Do not panic-spend on class swaps mid-run. Upgrade to shotgun before first elite-style spawns.

midLatePhase.title: Mid → late waves — class tools take over
midLatePhase.body: When pack sizes spike, lean on Tactician Spike Traps and Steel Barricades, Demolitionist Shockwave Bomb, and Necromancer Death Nova. Auto Skip becomes correct once your loadout outscales current payout.

faq.question: How many waves are there?
faq.answer: Public guides describe 500+ enemies per run with endless scaling — no fixed wave cap. Leaderboard ranks max wave reached, not a finish line.

faq.question: What is Auto Skip?
faq.answer: Server-wide vote to end buy phase early. Use once barricade + turret are placed and everyone has at least shotgun. Rushing skip before gear placement is a top beginner mistake.

faq.question: When should I swap classes?
faq.answer: Class unlocks are permanent and chosen in lobby before each run — not mid-run. Swap when your current class is no longer the limiting factor in wave count.

faq.question: What is Nightmare Mode?
faq.answer: Added May 8, 2026 per official Discord patch notes. External wave scaling and reward details are not published yet — treat as confirmed to exist, mechanics unverified.

faq.question: Best class for late waves?
faq.answer: Necromancer (S-tier, 250k) for solo leaderboard — Death Nova scales with density. Bastion (200k) for co-op squad survival via Bunker invincibility.
